title: Gestión de zonas
purpose: The administrator creates, edits, opens and closes parking zones and sets their capacity.

sections.name: Page header
sections.description: H1 'Zonas del parqueadero' and a navy button with a plus icon 'Nueva zona'.

sections.name: Zones table (left, 8 columns)
sections.description: White card table. image_generation_prompt:
Design a high-fidelity, pixel-perfect desktop web UI mockup (16:10, 2880x1800, front-on, flat, minimal browser frame) of the page "Gestión de zonas" for a university parking availability system called "Parqueadero USTA". All visible text must be in correct, readable Spanish, exactly as given below.
Style: modern Bootstrap-5 look with a premium finish - navy #1F2A44 navbar, gold #C9A227 accents, light background #F5F7FB, white cards with 16px radius and soft shadows, Inter font, generous white space, traffic-light status colors (green #198754, amber #F2A900, red #DC3545).
Shared elements: navbar (round gold 'P' badge + 'Parqueadero USTA', links: Disponibilidad, Registrar entrada, Vehículos adentro, Historial, Zonas, Vehículos; active link 'Zonas' underlined in gold) and footer ('Universidad Santo Tomás - Seccional Tunja · Desarrollo Orientado a Servicios 2026-2').
Page purpose: The administrator creates, edits, opens and closes parking zones and sets their capacity.
Section 1 - Page header: H1 'Zonas del parqueadero' and a navy button with a plus icon 'Nueva zona'.
Section 2 - Zones table (left, 8 columns): White card table. Columns: Nombre, Tipo (car or moto icon), Capacidad, Ocupados, Estado (iOS-style toggle switch with label 'Activa' or 'Cerrada'), Acciones (edit pencil icon button and a disabled trash icon). Rows: Zona A - Carros | Carro | 40 | 22 | Activa; Zona B - Carros | Carro | 30 | 19 | Activa; Zona Directivas | Carro | 10 | 9 | Activa; Zona Motos | Moto | 50 | 50 | Activa; Zona Visitantes | Carro | 15 | 0 | Cerrada (row slightly greyed out).
Section 3 - Form card (right, 4 columns): Sticky white card titled 'Nueva zona' with fields: text input 'Nombre' (value 'Zona Posgrados'), select 'Tipo de vehículo' (Carro), number input 'Capacidad' (value 20) with helper text 'Debe ser mayor que 0', checkbox/switch 'Zona activa' ON, and a full-width navy button 'Guardar zona'.
Section 4 - Success alert: Green alert at the top: 'Zona guardada correctamente'.
State to depict: Create-zone form partially filled and one closed zone in the table.
Avoid: lorem ipsum, gibberish or misspelled text, real brand or university logos, watermark, blurry text, distorted UI, stock photos of people, cartoon style, dark mode, perspective tilt, cut-off elements, cluttered layout.

output.presentation: flat, front-on UI screenshot inside a minimal browser window frame, readable Spanish text
